scope: USA Swimming — Western Zone: 16 new LSCs; Inland Empire retained. Complete zone LSC enumeration; partial regional, club and detailed contact collection.

evidence.inventoryCoverage: complete for named zone, against 2026 rulebook Article 605.1
evidence.duplicateCheck: Compared published knowledge_entries by stable ID, LSC code, title and official website; checked pending/held queue. No duplicate LSC additions.
evidence.fieldCoverage: Every new LSC includes name, code, type, website, geographic coverage, factual description, national and zone relationships, public contact, and checked source links.
evidence.limitations: No exhaustive collection of regional arrangements, clubs, all officers, or full legal entity names. Gaps and source conflicts are visible per record.
evidence.reviewInstruction: Stage only. Do not approve or publish.
